# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest major version of Velociradix receives security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 6.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 6.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of Velociradix seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately:

- **Email**: Contact `moaaz.yahia.zakaria@gmail.com`
- **GitHub**: Open a private security advisory on the [Velociradix Security Tab](https://github.com/Moaaz-i/Velociradix/security/advisories/new)

Please do **NOT** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

### Security Guarantees
- **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: Velociradix uses zero third-party npm packages to guarantee a clean supply chain.
- **Signed Provenance**: Official releases are built and signed via GitHub Actions OIDC Provenance.
